# CRD reference

Every AgentBox resource is a Kubernetes object in the `ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1` API group
with the same envelope:

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: HarnessRuntime
metadata:
  name: support-agent
spec: {}      # the fields below
status: {}    # written by the platform, never by you
```

Field names are camelCase. `metadata.name` is the resource name.
Sixteen kinds, two planes:

- **Serving plane** — [Model](#model), [ModelAutoScaler](#modelautoscaler), [HarnessRuntime](#harnessruntime), [HarnessSwarmAutoScaler](#harnessswarmautoscaler), [AgentIdP](#agentidp), [ToolServer](#toolserver), [ToolServerAutoScaler](#toolserverautoscaler), [Gateway](#gateway), [AIMetric](#aimetric), [AIMeter](#aimeter)
- **Training plane** — [TrainLoop](#trainloop), [Dataset](#dataset), [Evaluator](#evaluator), [Guardrail](#guardrail), [Tracer](#tracer), [Recipe](#recipe)

## Serving plane

### Model

A model the platform can serve or call: where the weights come from, what the model can do.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `models.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `mdl` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/model-schema.json`](../schemas/model-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/model.yaml`](../crds/model.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `modelName` | string | yes | Human-readable model name, as callers refer to it. |
| `modelHub` | enum | yes | Where the weights live. |
| `hubModelId` | string | yes | Model identifier within the hub, e.g. meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct. |
| `downloadApi` | `downloadApi` |  | How the platform fetches the weights, including auth. |
| `modelArchitecture` | `architecture` |  | Architecture family and layer/head geometry. |
| `modelSize` | `modelSize` |  | Parameter count and on-disk footprint, used for placement. |
| `contextWindow` | `contextWindow` |  | Maximum context and output length the model supports. |
| `supportsStreaming` | boolean |  | Whether the model can stream tokens. |
| `supportsFunctionCalling` | boolean |  | Whether the model supports tool/function calling. |
| `modalities` | `modalities` |  | Input and output modalities the model accepts. |
| `tags` | object |  | Free-form labels for discovery. |
| `replicas` | integer |  | Serving replicas. Ignored while a ModelAutoScaler owns this model. |
| `serving` | object |  | How to serve this model in-cluster. Omit for a registry-only entry that records what the model is without running anything. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- serving.image is required when serving is set

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Model
metadata:
  name: llama-3-70b-instruct
spec:
  modelName: Llama 3 70B Instruct
  modelHub: huggingface
  hubModelId: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct
```

### ModelAutoScaler

Scales a Model's replicas on queue depth, throughput or GPU utilisation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `modelautoscalers.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `mas` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/model-autoscaler-schema.json`](../schemas/model-autoscaler-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/model-autoscaler.yaml`](../crds/model-autoscaler.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scaleTargetRef` | object | yes | Model this autoscaler owns. |
| `bounds` | `replicaBounds` | yes | Replica floor and ceiling. |
| `metrics` | array&lt;`scalingMetric`&gt; | yes | Signals the scaling decision reads. Multiple metrics scale to the highest demand. |
| `behavior` | `scalingBehavior` |  | Stabilisation windows and rate limits on scale up and scale down. |
| `tolerance` | number |  | Relative deviation from target to ignore, so a metric hovering near its target does not cause churn. |
| `placement` | object |  | Where new replicas may land. Node supply itself is delegated to the existing cluster autoscaler CRDs. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Set false to pause scaling without deleting the autoscaler. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- bounds.maxReplicas must be >= bounds.minReplicas
- scaleTargetRef must reference a Model

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: ModelAutoScaler
metadata:
  name: llama-3-70b-autoscaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: Model
    name: llama-3-70b-instruct
  bounds:
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 8
  metrics:
  - type: aiMetric
    metric: inference-queue-depth
    target:
      metricType: averageValue
      value: 20
  - type: resource
    resource: gpu
    target:
      metricType: utilization
      value: 75
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 600
    scaleToZero:
      enabled: false
```

### HarnessRuntime

Runs a developer's agent image as a Kubernetes workload.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `harnessruntimes.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `hr` |
| Backing workload | Deployment + Service, Job, or CronJob (by `spec.runtimeKind`) |
| Schema | [`schemas/harness-runtime-schema.json`](../schemas/harness-runtime-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/harness-runtime.yaml`](../crds/harness-runtime.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runtimeKind` | enum | yes | Workload shape backing this harness. |
| `code` | `code` | yes | The developer-supplied image to run. |
| `replicas` | integer |  | Desired replicas. Ignored while a HarnessSwarmAutoScaler owns this harness. |
| `compute` | `computeResources` |  | CPU, memory, GPU and storage requested per replica. |
| `env` | object |  | Environment variables passed to the image. Secret-looking values are moved into a Secret. |
| `endpoints` | array&lt;`endpoint`&gt; |  | Ports the harness serves on. A Service is created for these. |
| `schedule` | `schedule` |  | Only meaningful when runtime_kind is cron. |
| `health` | `health` |  | Readiness probe for the harness container. |
| `files` | object |  | Files written into the container from a ConfigMap or Secret. The key is the mount path. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- schedule is required when runtimeKind is cron
- a server harness must declare at least one endpoint
- health.command is required when health.type is exec
- env keys must be valid environment variable names

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: HarnessRuntime
metadata:
  name: api-harness
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/version: 1.4.0
spec:
  runtimeKind: server
  code:
    image: acme/support-agent:1.4.0
    entrypoint: /app/serve
  replicas: 2
  compute:
    cpu:
      cores: 4
      memoryMb: 8192
  endpoints:
  - name: api
    interface: http
    port: 8080
    path: /api
  health:
    type: http
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
```

### HarnessSwarmAutoScaler

Scales a swarm of harnesses on session and queue pressure.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `harnessswarmautoscalers.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `hsas` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/harness-swarm-autoscaler-schema.json`](../schemas/harness-swarm-autoscaler-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/harness-swarm-autoscaler.yaml`](../crds/harness-swarm-autoscaler.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scaleTargetRef` | object | yes | HarnessRuntime whose swarm this autoscaler owns. |
| `bounds` | `replicaBounds` | yes | Replica floor and ceiling for the swarm. |
| `metrics` | array&lt;`scalingMetric`&gt; | yes | Signals the scaling decision reads, typically pending sessions or queue depth. |
| `behavior` | `scalingBehavior` |  | Stabilisation windows and rate limits on scale up and scale down. |
| `tolerance` | number |  | Relative deviation from target to ignore, so a metric hovering near its target does not cause churn. |
| `sessionAffinity` | object |  | How in-flight agent sessions are treated while the swarm resizes. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Set false to pause scaling without deleting the autoscaler. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- bounds.maxReplicas must be >= bounds.minReplicas
- scaleTargetRef must reference a HarnessRuntime

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: HarnessSwarmAutoScaler
metadata:
  name: api-harness-swarm
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: HarnessRuntime
    name: api-harness
  bounds:
    minReplicas: 0
    maxReplicas: 50
  metrics:
  - type: aiMetric
    metric: pending-agent-sessions
    target:
      metricType: averageValue
      value: 5
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
    scaleToZero:
      enabled: true
      idleSeconds: 600
  sessionAffinity:
    enabled: true
    maxSessionsPerHarness: 8
```

### AgentIdP

Issues workload identity to agents and groups the policies that apply to them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `agentidps.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `idp` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/agent-idp-schema.json`](../schemas/agent-idp-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/agent-idp.yaml`](../crds/agent-idp.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Human-readable name for this identity provider. |
| `description` | string |  | What this identity provider covers. |
| `status` | enum | yes | Whether this identity provider is in force. |
| `identity` | array&lt;`identity`&gt; |  | Identity matchers: which roles, service accounts or tags this applies to. |
| `policyGroups` | array&lt;`policyGroup`&gt; |  | Ordered groups of guardrails, with conflict resolution between them. |
| `defaultBehavior` | enum |  | What happens when no policy matches: allow or deny. |
| `inheritFrom` | string |  | Name of another AgentIdP whose policy groups are inherited. |

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: AgentIdP
metadata:
  name: default-idp
spec:
  status: active
  identity:
  - type: role
    roles:
    - admin
  defaultBehavior: deny
```

### ToolServer

Runs an image that serves tools over HTTP or gRPC, and publishes their contracts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `toolservers.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `ts` |
| Backing workload | Deployment + Service |
| Schema | [`schemas/tool-server-schema.json`](../schemas/tool-server-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/tool-server.yaml`](../crds/tool-server.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `code` | yes | The image that serves the tools. |
| `endpoint` | `endpoint` | yes | Port and base path the server listens on. A Service is created for it. |
| `tools` | array&lt;`tool`&gt; | yes | Contracts for the tools this server exposes, so callers can discover them. |
| `replicas` | integer |  | Desired replicas. Ignored while a ToolServerAutoScaler owns this server. |
| `compute` | `computeResources` |  | CPU, memory, GPU and storage requested per replica. |
| `env` | object |  | Environment variables passed to the image. Secret-looking values are moved into a Secret. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Set false to keep the definition but stop serving. |
| `version` | string |  | Version of the tool contracts, for callers that pin. |
| `stateManagement` | `stateManagement` |  | Whether tool calls carry state, and where that state lives. |
| `permissions` | `permissions` |  | Scopes and roles required to call these tools. |
| `monitoring` | `monitoring` |  | Logging and metric collection for tool calls. |
| `files` | object |  | Files written into the container from a ConfigMap or Secret. The key is the mount path. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- tool names must be unique within a tool server
- env keys must be valid environment variable names

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: ToolServer
metadata:
  name: summarize-text
spec:
  code:
    image: acme/text-tools:2.1.0
  endpoint:
    interface: http
    port: 8080
    basePath: /tools
  tools:
  - name: summarize-text
    description: Summarize input text into a short abstract
    path: /summarize
    parameters:
      type: object
      properties:
        text:
          type: string
      required:
      - text
    returns:
      type: object
      description: Summarization result
  replicas: 2
```

### ToolServerAutoScaler

Scales a ToolServer on call rate, concurrency and latency.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `toolserverautoscalers.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `tsas` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/tool-server-autoscaler-schema.json`](../schemas/tool-server-autoscaler-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/tool-server-autoscaler.yaml`](../crds/tool-server-autoscaler.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scaleTargetRef` | object | yes | ToolServer this autoscaler owns. |
| `bounds` | `replicaBounds` | yes | Replica floor and ceiling for the tool server. |
| `metrics` | array&lt;`scalingMetric`&gt; | yes | Signals the scaling decision reads, typically call rate or latency. |
| `behavior` | `scalingBehavior` |  | Stabilisation windows and rate limits on scale up and scale down. |
| `tolerance` | number |  | Relative deviation from target to ignore, so a metric hovering near its target does not cause churn. |
| `concurrency` | object |  | Per-replica concurrency envelope used to derive the replica target. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Set false to pause scaling without deleting the autoscaler. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- bounds.maxReplicas must be >= bounds.minReplicas
- scaleTargetRef must reference a ToolServer

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: ToolServerAutoScaler
metadata:
  name: summarize-text-autoscaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: ToolServer
    name: summarize-text
  bounds:
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 20
  metrics:
  - type: aiMetric
    metric: tool-call-rate
    target:
      metricType: averageValue
      value: 50
  concurrency:
    targetInFlightCalls: 10
    maxInFlightCalls: 25
```

### Gateway

Routes model traffic to a provider, with rate limits and per-model parameters.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `gateways.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `gw` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/gateway-schema.json`](../schemas/gateway-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/gateway.yaml`](../crds/gateway.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `modelName` | string | yes | Name callers use when routing through this gateway. |
| `litellmParams` | `litellmParams` | yes | Upstream provider, credentials and per-model runtime parameters. |
| `modelInfo` | `modelInfo` | yes | Capabilities advertised to callers: mode, function calling, vision, streaming. |
| `serving` | object |  | How to run the gateway in-cluster. Omit to publish the routing config for a gateway you already run. |
| `replicas` | integer |  | Gateway replicas, when serving is set. |

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: openai-compatible
spec:
  modelName: llama-3-70b-instruct
  litellmParams:
    model: openai/llama-3-70b-instruct
    apiBase: http://localhost:8000/v1
  modelInfo:
    id: llama-3-70b-instruct
    mode: chat
```

### AIMetric

Defines a metric derived from traces, other metrics, or a model judgement.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `aimetrics.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `aim` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/ai-metric-schema.json`](../schemas/ai-metric-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/ai-metric.yaml`](../crds/ai-metric.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | yes | How the value is produced: from traces, from other metrics, or by a model. |
| `namespace` | string |  | Metric namespace, used to group related metrics. |
| `metricName` | string | yes | Metric name as exported. |
| `description` | string |  | What this metric measures. |
| `category` | enum |  | Broad classification, e.g. performance, cost or quality. |
| `status` | enum |  | Whether this metric is being collected. |
| `calculated` | boolean |  | Whether the value is derived rather than observed directly. |
| `sourceType` | enum |  | Origin of the underlying signal. |
| `fromLogs` | `fromLogs` |  | How to extract the value from trace and log records. |
| `metricMath` | `metricMathBlock` |  | Expression combining other metrics into this one. |
| `dimensions` | array |  | Dimensions the metric is broken down by. |
| `unit` | enum |  | Unit of the emitted value. |
| `statistic` | enum |  | Default statistic applied over the period. |
| `periodSeconds` | integer |  | Aggregation period. |
| `storageResolutionSeconds` | integer |  | Resolution the metric is stored at. |
| `windowing` | `windowing` |  | Window shape used when aggregating. |
| `aggregation` | `aggregation` |  | How values are rolled up across dimensions. |
| `retention` | `retention` |  | How long values are kept. |
| `export` | `export` |  | Where the metric is exported to. |
| `permissions` | `permissions` |  | Who may read this metric. |
| `tags` | object |  | Free-form labels for discovery. |
| `enforcement` | object |  | Whether guardrails may act on this metric. |

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: AIMetric
metadata:
  name: request-latency
spec:
  type: base
  metricName: request_latency_ms
  unit: Milliseconds
  statistic: Average
  periodSeconds: 60
  fromLogs:
    logQuery:
      conditions:
      - path: attributes.event
        op: eq
        value: request_complete
      timeRangeSeconds: 60
    valueSelector:
      type: avg
      path: attributes.duration_ms
      cast: float
```

### AIMeter

Turns metrics into attributed, priced, budgeted usage.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `aimeters.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `aime` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/ai-meter-schema.json`](../schemas/ai-meter-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/ai-meter.yaml`](../crds/ai-meter.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `usage` | object | yes | What is being metered and where the raw counts come from. |
| `attribution` | object |  | Dimensions the usage is split by, typically the billing tenant. |
| `window` | object | yes | Accounting window: tumbling, sliding, or a billing period. |
| `pricing` | object |  | Optional cost model applied to metered usage. |
| `budget` | object |  | Quota or spend ceiling enforced for the window. |
| `export` | object |  | Where metered records are emitted for billing or analytics. |
| `retentionDays` | integer |  | How long metered records are kept. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Set false to stop metering without deleting the meter. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- window.period is required for a billingPeriod window
- window.durationSeconds is required for tumbling and sliding windows
- pricing.tiers is required when pricing.model is tiered

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: AIMeter
metadata:
  name: tenant-token-spend
spec:
  usage:
    unit: totalTokens
    source:
      metric: gateway-tokens
      statistic: Sum
    subjects:
    - openai-compatible
  attribution:
    dimensions:
    - tenant_id
  window:
    type: billingPeriod
    period: monthly
  pricing:
    currency: USD
    model: perUnit
    unitPrice: 0.6
    perUnits: 1000000
  budget:
    limit: 5000
    limitType: cost
    onExceed: throttle
```

## Training plane

### TrainLoop

Runs a training or evaluation job, once or on a schedule.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `trainloops.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `tl` |
| Backing workload | Job, or CronJob when `spec.execution.schedule` is set |
| Schema | [`schemas/train-loop-schema.json`](../schemas/train-loop-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/train-loop.yaml`](../crds/train-loop.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Human-readable name for this loop. |
| `description` | string |  | What this loop trains or evaluates. |
| `type` | enum | yes | What kind of work this loop performs. |
| `version` | string | yes | Version of this loop's definition. |
| `status` | enum | yes | Whether the loop is running, paused or stopped. |
| `worker` | `worker` | yes | The image that performs the work, and the compute it needs. |
| `execution` | `execution` | yes | When and how the loop runs: continuously, on a schedule, or on an event. |
| `stateManagement` | `stateManagement` |  | Where checkpoints and run state are stored. |
| `lifecycle` | `lifecycle` |  | Pause, resume and restart behaviour. |
| `health` | `health` |  | Metrics watched to decide whether the loop is healthy. |
| `observability` | `observability` |  | Logging, tracing and metric emission for runs. |
| `permissions` | `permissions` |  | Who may start, pause and inspect this loop. |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form annotations. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- execution.schedule is required when execution.mode is scheduled

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: TrainLoop
metadata:
  name: sft-nightly
spec:
  type: training
  version: 1.0.0
  status: active
  worker:
    image: acme/trainer:1.0.0
    env:
      EPOCHS: '3'
  execution:
    mode: scheduled
    timeoutSeconds: 7200
    schedule:
      type: cron
      cronExpression: 0 2 * * *
```

### Dataset

A connector-backed source or sink, with cursor state and checkpointing.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `datasets.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `ds` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/dataset-schema.json`](../schemas/dataset-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/dataset.yaml`](../crds/dataset.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Human-readable name |
| `type` | enum | yes | Connector type. Determines which config variant is required. |
| `direction` | enum | yes | Whether this dataset is read from, written to, or both. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | Set false to keep the definition but stop moving data. |
| `config` | object | yes | Connector configuration. Set exactly the variant matching spec.type. |
| `stateManagement` | `stateManagement` |  | Cursor and checkpoint behaviour for incremental reads. |
| `metadata` | `metadata` |  | Free-form annotations. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- exactly one config variant must be set
- config.httpPoll is required when type is httpPoll
- config.webhook is required when type is webhook
- config.kafka is required when type is kafka
- config.queue is required when type is queue
- config.s3 is required when type is s3
- config.fs is required when type is fs
- config.database is required when type is database
- config.grpc is required when type is grpc
- config.pubsub is required when type is pubsub

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Dataset
metadata:
  name: orders-stream
spec:
  name: Orders API Polling
  type: httpPoll
  direction: source
  enabled: true
  config:
    httpPoll:
      url: https://api.example.com/orders
      method: GET
      intervalSeconds: 60
```

### Evaluator

An evaluation suite: cases plus how to score them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `evaluators.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `ev` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/evaluator-schema.json`](../schemas/evaluator-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/evaluator.yaml`](../crds/evaluator.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Human-readable name for this evaluation suite. |
| `description` | string |  | What this suite measures. |
| `dataset` | `dataset` | yes | Where the evaluation cases come from. |
| `scoring` | `scoring` | yes | Metrics applied to each case, and how they combine into a score. |
| `runConfig` | `runConfig` |  | Concurrency, retries and sampling for a run. |
| `tags` | object |  | Free-form labels for discovery. |
| `metadata` | object |  | Free-form annotations. |

Enforced by the API server as CEL validation rules:

- exactly one dataset source must be set

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Evaluator
metadata:
  name: summarization-accuracy
spec:
  name: Summarization Accuracy
  dataset:
    inline:
      cases:
      - id: case1
        input:
          text: The quick brown fox.
        expected: quick brown fox
  scoring:
    metrics:
    - metric:
        type: contains
        needle: quick brown fox
      weight: 1
```

### Guardrail

A metric-driven condition and the effect enforced when it trips.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `guardrails.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `gr` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/guardrail-schema.json`](../schemas/guardrail-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/guardrail.yaml`](../crds/guardrail.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Human-readable name for this guardrail. |
| `description` | string |  | What this guardrail protects against. |
| `status` | enum | yes | Whether the guardrail is enforced, permissive or disabled. |
| `priority` | integer | yes | Evaluation order. Lower numbers are evaluated first. |
| `metricsSource` | enum |  | Where the metrics in the conditions are read from. |
| `requireValidLogs` | boolean |  | Whether to fail closed when the underlying signal is missing. |
| `scope` | `scope` |  | Which resources this guardrail applies to. |
| `conditions` | `conditionsBlock` | yes | Metric conditions that trip this guardrail. |
| `metricMath` | `metricMath` |  | Expression evaluated over metrics before the conditions. |
| `effect` | `effect` | yes | What happens when the conditions trip. |
| `cooldownSeconds` | integer |  | Minimum time between two firings. |
| `suppressForSeconds` | integer |  | How long to stay silent after firing. |
| `tags` | object |  | Free-form labels for discovery. |

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Guardrail
metadata:
  name: throttle-high-rps
spec:
  name: Throttle on high request rate
  status: enforce
  priority: 10
  conditions:
    all:
    - metric: request-rate
      operator: gt
      threshold: 1000
      statistic: Average
      periodSeconds: 60
  effect:
    type: throttle
    parameters:
      throttlePercent: 20
```

### Tracer

Where traces and logs are exported, in OpenTelemetry shape.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `tracers.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `tr` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/tracer-schema.json`](../schemas/tracer-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/tracer.yaml`](../crds/tracer.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource` | `resource` | yes | Resource attributes attached to every record, e.g. service name. |
| `resourceSchemaUrl` | string |  | Schema URL for the resource attributes. |
| `scope` | `scope` |  | Instrumentation scope emitting these records. |
| `scopeSchemaUrl` | string |  | Schema URL for the scope. |
| `logRecords` | array&lt;`logRecord`&gt; | yes | Trace and log records, in OpenTelemetry shape. |

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Tracer
metadata:
  name: otel-default
spec:
  resource:
    attributes:
    - key: service.name
      value:
        type: string
        stringValue: agentbox-api
  logRecords:
  - timeUnixNano: 1718123456789000000
    severityNumber: 9
    severityText: INFO
    body:
      type: string
      stringValue: Processed 42 events
```

### Recipe

A composable multi-stage pipeline definition.

| | |
|---|---|
| Resource | `recipes.ai.agentbox.io` |
| Short names | `rcp` |
| Backing workload | none — configuration only |
| Schema | [`schemas/recipe-schema.json`](../schemas/recipe-schema.json) |
| Manifest | [`crds/recipe.yaml`](../crds/recipe.yaml) |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coreMetadata` | `coreMetadata` | yes | Identity of the recipe: type, version and lifecycle status. |
| `ioSpecification` | `ioSpecification` |  | Input and output contracts for the pipeline. |
| `executionDefinition` | `executionDefinition` | yes | Ordered stages and their dependencies. |
| `runtimeConfiguration` | object |  | State, concurrency and resources for a run. |
| `optimization` | `optimization` |  | Caching, batching and other execution optimisations. |
| `observability` | `observability` |  | Logging, tracing and metric emission for runs. |
| `operational` | `operational` |  | Timeouts, retries and failure handling. |
| `dependencies` | `dependencies` |  | Other recipes or resources this one needs. |
| `metadata` | `meta` |  | Free-form annotations. |

```yaml
apiVersion: ai.agentbox.io/v1beta1
kind: Recipe
metadata:
  name: nightly-sft
spec:
  coreMetadata:
    description: Nightly supervised fine-tuning pass
    type: modelTraining
    version: 1.0.0
    status: active
  executionDefinition:
    stages:
    - id: ingest
      name: Load dataset
      type: ingest
    - id: train
      name: Fine-tune
      type: train
      dependsOn:
      - ingest
```
